snippet.title: Coin Maker Simulator - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Enjoy the crafting process in this immersive, relaxing simulator about making money, literally. You've been locked in a dungeon, and your only way to freedom is to craft coins for the King!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4156710/Coin_Maker_Simulator/
